conceptual_change: Implement a state-transition buffer class that gates SMA crossover order execution by requiring that the 1-hour candle close is currently trading above/below the long-term trend indicator value at the moment of crossover signal generation.
rationale: The previous rejection noted that the conceptual change required an explicit engine implementation; this hypothesis formalizes the logic into a testable state-transition condition that enforces the requested confirmation candle alignment.
